the homogenization in the sense of convergence of densities of the associated evolution equations and in the sense of weak convergence of the associated processes.
the homogenization problem for stochastic processes and their associated evolution equations in the presence of a local and a nonlocal component.

we study the homogonization of a stochastic system in which a nonlocal part survives in the limit.

the limit process is a nonlocal one, even though the local part is present in the partitions.
